spans.s: Vegavat^1, a serpent. § 67 (Sarpasattra): I, 57, 2158 (of Dhṛtarāshṭra's race).

Vegavat^2, one or more Asuras. § 92 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2532 (among the sons of Danu).--§ 130 (do.): I, 67, 2646 (incarnate as one of the Kaikeya princes).--§ 320 (Saubhavadhop.): III, 16, 675 (Daiteyaḥ), 676, 678 (follower of Śālva; slain by Śāmba).
Vegavat^3, a Rākshasa. § 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 91, 4083 (slain by Duryodhana).
